# ref E7H-1421
"""Read lines from stdin; print valid/invalid per non-blank line, then the counts."""
import re
import sys

PATTERN = re.compile(r"[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}")
DAYS = [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]


def is_valid(text):
    if not PATTERN.fullmatch(text):
        return False
    year, month, day = int(text[0:4]), int(text[5:7]), int(text[8:10])
    if not 1 <= month <= 12:
        return False
    limit = DAYS[month - 1]
    if month == 2 and year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0):
        limit = 29
    return 1 <= day <= limit


def main():
    valid = invalid = 0
    for raw in sys.stdin:
        line = raw.rstrip("\r\n")
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        if is_valid(line):
            valid += 1
            print("valid")
        else:
            invalid += 1
            print("invalid")
    print(f"valid={valid} invalid={invalid}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF
